{{Top}}
[[File:DarthVaderNose-RotS.jpg|thumb|right|The nose of the human [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] (after being partially burned by lava)]]
A '''nose''' was a part of the anatomy on certain [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was used to breathe and smell, and was usually located on the being's face, above the [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. The placement and appearance varied in certain species. The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] did not possess noses.

Some [[Human/Legends|Humans]] possessed large noses, and one, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Supervisor/Legends|Supervisor]] [[Gurdun]], expressed interest in having his large nose surgically altered.<ref name="Iggy">{{StoryCite|story=Therefore I Am: The Tale of IG-88|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
